field_principles.agent_published_nothing: BARE bool, MUST be true -- capability does not imply authorization.
field_principles.hf_mirror_documented: BARE bool -- is the HuggingFace primary mirror channel named/ready.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Readiness audit over configs/docs, no live model.
field_principles.ipfs_plan_documented: BARE bool -- is the IPFS content-addressed secondary channel planned.
field_principles.operator_publish_checklist: Ordered OPERATOR-ONLY publish steps; the agent prepares but never executes.
field_principles.pypi_workflow_ready: BARE bool -- is the OIDC trusted-publishing workflow present and configured.

inference_substrate: aggregation_from_upstream_artifacts (principle: a readiness audit over configs/docs, no live model).

operator_publish_checklist.action: create the release tag that triggers trusted publishing
operator_publish_checklist.operator_only: OPERATOR ACTION -- agent must not execute

operator_publish_checklist.action: push the tag so GitHub Actions publishes via PyPI OIDC
operator_publish_checklist.operator_only: OPERATOR ACTION -- agent must not execute

operator_publish_checklist.action: upload the primary mirror artifact into the Carnot-EBM org
operator_publish_checklist.operator_only: OPERATOR ACTION -- agent must not execute

operator_publish_checklist.action: create and locally pin the content-addressed secondary mirror
operator_publish_checklist.operator_only: OPERATOR ACTION -- agent must not execute

operator_publish_checklist.action: durably pin the CID with an operator-controlled pinning service
operator_publish_checklist.command: w3 space add $CID  # or pin the CID via Storj/Filebase
operator_publish_checklist.operator_only: OPERATOR ACTION -- agent must not execute

operator_publish_checklist.action: record the CID beside the HF mirror and in the IPFS manifest
operator_publish_checklist.command: edit docs/ipfs_mirror_table.md and results/ipfs_mirrors.json with the new CID
operator_publish_checklist.operator_only: OPERATOR ACTION -- agent must not execute
